title: Herbal Hash Breakfast Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious breakfast bowl made with herbal hash, kissed potatoes, and ethiopian spices. This dish is perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Toss the kissed potatoes with herbal oils, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20 minutes.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of herbal oils over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the hash to the pan and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the Ethiopian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Fluff the roasted potatoes with a fork and add them to the pan with the hash mixture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the herbal hash breakfast bowl hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
